# Cultural Moment Benchmark (CMB)

> A video benchmark for cultural understanding in Southeast Asia, published at
> the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. It scores three abilities separately rather
> than as one number: naming a cultural concept from a symbolic description,
> recognizing it among unlabeled video moments, and localizing its sub-events in
> time inside a different video of the same concept.

Project page: https://culturalmoment-benchmark.github.io/
Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23065 (arXiv:2608.23065)
Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Multimedia-SMU/culturalmoment-benchmark
Licence: data CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; website CC BY-SA 4.0
Contact: buraks@smu.edu.sg

## What it contains

- 306 expert-curated cultural concepts from seven countries in Southeast Asia:
  Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines and Vietnam (Latin script), and Cambodia,
  Myanmar and Thailand (non-Latin scripts).
- Five categories: celebration, dance, game, music, wedding.
- 624 videos kept by local annotators from about 6,120 candidates. Set A is one
  video per concept (306 videos, 2.0 minutes on average) and drives Stage 2.
  Set B is 318 videos (6.2 minutes on average) and drives Stage 3.
- All visual ground truth is produced by humans. The release references source
  videos by YouTube ID and does not redistribute video bytes.

## The task

Three stages, evaluated under three context modes (Reset, Carry, Feedback):

1. Stage 1, naming: identify the concept from a symbolic description, not from
   what is visible. Questions answerable by generic object recognition are
   rejected at construction.
2. Stage 2, recognition: pick the concept among unlabeled candidate video
   moments.
3. Stage 3, temporal localization: locate the concept's sub-events in time,
   free-form, in a different video of the same concept.

## Key findings

- Best end-to-end score is 27.8%. Even Gemini 3.1 Pro clears all three stages
  for fewer than 3 in 10 concepts. Open-source models land in single digits.
- The cascade breaks. Correct naming lifts moment recognition by about 18 points
  for the strongest models, but correct recognition adds nothing when localizing
  on a fresh clip. Specialist grounding models top out at 19.3 mIoU against 33.4
  for the best VLM.
- Context widens the gap. With prior context Gemini's recognition climbs to
  85.9% while InternVL's falls to 9.8%.
- Audio can mislead. The share of videos where audio distracts doubles in
  non-Latin-script countries.
- The knowledge is country-specific, not regional. Expert raters fall to 21.3%,
  below the 25% chance line, when naming a neighbouring country's concepts.

## Related

- Seeing Culture Benchmark (SCB, EMNLP 2025), the image predecessor that
  established the reason-then-ground design: https://seeingculture-benchmark.github.io/
- First author's homepage: https://buraksatar.github.io/

## Leaderboard and submissions

The leaderboard on the project page covers six vision-language models under all
three modes. External submissions are accepted; see the Submit section of
https://culturalmoment-benchmark.github.io/
